title: Partnership Outside Basis and Capital Accounts: A Simple Example
description: A partner's tax basis is not interchangeable with the capital account on a K-1. Follow a contribution and debt example to see why the distinction matters.

title: Partnership Cash Distributions: Check Basis Before Paying Partners
description: Cash distributions change the partner's basis and can create gain. Use a simplified example to connect payment approvals with current basis records.

title: Guaranteed Payments and Partnership Distributions: Different Tax Jobs
description: A partner's recurring payment may be a guaranteed payment, a distribution or another transaction. Learn why the agreement and payment purpose matter.

title: Partnership Liabilities: Basis and At-Risk Are Separate Tests
description: A liability can affect outside basis without producing the same amount at risk. This guide explains the distinction before a partnership loss is claimed.

title: Buying a Partnership Interest: Buyer Basis and Section 754 Questions
description: A partnership interest purchase changes the buyer's tax investment, but partnership asset basis may need a separate adjustment analysis. Build the acquisition file early.

title: Partnership Losses and Section 461(l): A 2026 Partner Example
description: A partnership K-1 loss passes through several partner-level tests. See how the excess business loss limit applies after earlier restrictions and other business income.

title: Partnership Tax Strategies: AE Tax Advisors Companion Reading Guides
description: Read six focused partnership tax strategies companion guides with worked examples, records checklists, IRS references and links to published AE Tax Advisors case studies.
